summary: Recent updates to the HLS (HTTP Live Streaming) support in Firefox enhance how the browser handles media streams. With the changes, HLS is now regarded as a **media source**, which allows for improved integration with other media features. Additionally, the updates streamline callback mechanisms, making it easier for developers to manage various elements of HLS content. These improvements are significant for delivering a smoother streaming experience, ensuring users receive high-quality video playback without interruptions.
